result:
Disk full → db write failed → api killed itself, never came back.

`report-export` job wrote 40 × 512 MB CSVs (~20 GB) into `/var/lib/stockroom/exports/` between 03:05:00 and 03:12:48, same volume as the database. Disk hit 91% at 03:09:03, 99% at 03:13:30. Then:

```
03:14:00 ERROR db: could not extend file "base/16384/2619": No space left on device
03:14:03 ERROR api: transaction aborted, shutting down worker pool
03:14:06 FATAL api: exiting (status 1)
```

Last successful api request 03:13:51. From 03:16:00 proxy logs `upstream api refused connection` every 2 min, 67 times, still going at 03:28 → 05:28; log ends 05:29:57 with api still down. No restart attempt logged, so nothing supervised it back up, and it would have failed again anyway with disk still full. Web and proxy kept serving 200s throughout; only api was out.

Unrelated noise: `cache: slow command` WARNs (100–149 ms) every ~5 min from 02:00, same before and after the crash.

Not in the log: what triggered the export or why it was that large, and whether it finished or just ran out of space. Job isn't defined anywhere in this repo, so can't check from here.

Log timestamps are 2026-03-09, not last night (today is 2026-10-08). If this is a stale sample, the real incident may differ; point me at the current log if so.

Recovery: free space in `exports/`, restart api. Prevention: exports on a separate volume or size-capped, alert before 90%, restart policy on api.

Separately: chisle statusline badge isn't configured; say the word and I'll add it to `settings.json`.
